subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository approve these 14 coordinated action-runtime upgrades for the secret-bearing, security-scanning, agent, and release workflows after the exact-head gates complete?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but CODEOWNERS assigns several touched workflows to security operations and the updated actions execute with credentials or publishing/scanning privileges that require explicit human ownership approval.

options.title: Approve coordinated refresh
options.body: Rebase the branch, complete the required security and automation checks, and approve the immutable-pin update as one coordinated dependency refresh.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing action upgrades into narrower PRs if maintainers want isolated validation and rollback.

options.title: Defer the bulk update
options.body: Pause this PR if representative secret-bearing or release-path validation cannot be completed confidently.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, complete the required security and automation checks, and approve the immutable-pin update as one coordinated dependency refresh.
